items.title: Hack The Box Wins Multiple 2026 Cybersecurity Industry Awards for Advancing Cybersecurity Workforce Readiness
items.description: Industry recognition highlights HTB’s approach to developing and measuring capabilities across the human-AI workforce as its global community surpasses 5 million members

items.title: Beyond the competition: How Hack The Box and Google Cloud are building a stronger security community
items.description: Hack The Box and Google Cloud joined forces to host a first-of-its-kind Google Cloud Security Community virtual Capture The Flag (CTF) competition designed to give security practitioners the opportunity to get hands-on with realistic attack scenarios, build familiarity with essential security operations tools, and sharpen the investigative skills they rely on in their day-to-day roles.

items.title: Six forces reshaping cybersecurity and what your workforce must prove next
items.description: AI is changing who performs security work, how decisions get made, and what competence looks like. Six connected forces explain why workforce readiness now means developing your people and appraising the agents working beside them.

items.title: Hack The Box and RemoteThreat Partner to Advance Realistic Evaluation for Human-AI Cyber Operations
items.description: Strategic collaboration combines HTB’s cyber ranges with RemoteThreat’s offensive security research expertise to strengthen operator competence, agent evaluation, and human-AI teaming.

items.title: What building a realistic Azure attack environment teaches you about cloud security
items.description: Most companies now run at least part of their environment in the cloud, and attackers have moved there with them. Training material has not kept up. You can find a lot of content on on-premises Active Directory, but much less on realistic Azure and Entra ID attacks.

items.title: After Black October: The New Climate
items.description: In late October PHP broke, and most of us have already moved on On 21 October, two bugs in PHP briefly looked like the end of the world. PHP runs roughly 70% of websites whose server-side language is known. Finland, the Netherlands and France pulled government sites offline. Patches shipped in a day, the leaked exploits mostly didn't work, and by that Friday most of us had moved on.

items.title: Standard Chartered and Hack The Box Unite Poland’s Financial Sector to Advance Cyber Workforce Readiness
items.description: Operation Cyber Eagle brought together 47 security practitioners across 12 major financial institutions in Warsaw to stress-test hands-on capabilities, tackle emerging AI vulnerabilities, and foster cross-sector defense.

items.title: Study Finds Hack The Box Cybersecurity Platform Delivered 330% Return on Investment
items.description: Enterprises achieved payback in less than six months, strengthened cyber workforce readiness, improved security operations and reduced breach risk

items.title: Five Takeaways for Security Leaders Building Human and Agentic Teams
items.description: AI can help security teams move faster. But speed alone does not tell you whether people are making sound decisions or whether agents are still doing the job to the expected standard.
